about: National share of U.S. adults supporting YES on each policy question as phrased, among those with an opinion, with Democratic and Republican splits where polled. Recent reputable polls (2020-2026) or ballot results; estimate=true rows use the closest poll and say how. Figures are checks on totals, never an actor's outcome.

us-policy-positions:agriculture-natural-.poll: Colorado College Conservation in the West, 2024 (8 Western states), water conservation rules
us-policy-positions:agriculture-natural-.basis: No national groundwater-limit poll; Western-state water conservation support, discounted

us-policy-positions:agriculture-natural-.poll: Farmland protection polling summarized by American Farmland Trust
us-policy-positions:agriculture-natural-.basis: Advocacy-commissioned surveys; bipartisan, discounted for sponsor

us-policy-positions:business-commerce.ca.poll: Ballot: Nebraska Initiative 428, Nov 2020, 36% payday rate cap passed 83%; South Dakota 2016 passed 76%
us-policy-positions:business-commerce.ca.basis: Ballot results in red states; party split not polled

us-policy-positions:business-commerce.le.poll: Gallup, Oct 2025, marijuana use should be made legal

us-policy-positions:civil-family-communi.poll: PRRI American Values Atlas, 2023, laws protecting LGBTQ people from discrimination in jobs, housing
Pew, 2025, abortion should be illegal in all or most cases (63% legal)
us-policy-positions:civil-family-communi.basis: Restrict = illegal all/most; abortion-rights side won 14 of 17 ballot measures 2022-2024

us-policy-positions:education.public-fun.poll: Education Next poll, 2024, universal vouchers/ESAs; 2024 ballots lost in KY (35%), NE, CO
us-policy-positions:education.public-fun.basis: Polls near even; recent ballot measures all failed

us-policy-positions:education.raise-teac.poll: PDK Poll, 2023, about two-thirds say teachers are underpaid
us-policy-positions:education.raise-teac.basis: Teacher-pay sentiment as proxy for a state salary floor

us-policy-positions:education.universal-.poll: Morning Consult/Politico, 2021, universal pre-K for 3- and 4-year-olds

us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.poll: State polls on container deposit laws, summarized by Container Recycling Institute
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.basis: No national poll; state polls consistently 70-85%

us-policy-positions:environment-energy.c.poll: Pew, 2023-2024, tougher limits on power plant emissions
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.c.basis: Emission-limit support as proxy for a county clean-air plan

us-policy-positions:environment-energy.c.poll: Pew, June 2024, prioritize renewables; Yale CCAM, require utilities to use clean power

us-policy-positions:environment-energy.p.poll: Yale CCAM, 2024, carbon tax with tax offset (~2/3); AP-NORC/EPIC 2023, support falls when costs named
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.p.basis: Blend of revenue-neutral and cost-named wording

us-policy-positions:fiscal.adopt-income-.poll: Ballot: WA I-1098 (2010) lost 36%; MA surtax (2022) passed 52%
us-policy-positions:fiscal.adopt-income-.basis: No national poll on having a state income tax; ballot results and tax views

us-policy-positions:fiscal.balanced-oper.poll: Gallup, balanced budget amendment, roughly three in four favor
us-policy-positions:fiscal.balanced-oper.basis: Federal balanced-budget polls as proxy; pre-2020

us-policy-positions:fiscal.cap-property-.poll: State ballot results on property tax limits (e.g., FL, AZ, TX 2023 relief passed 80%+)

us-policy-positions:fiscal.exempt-grocer.poll: State polls and legislation on grocery tax repeal (e.g., AR, MS, IL 2023-2025)
us-policy-positions:fiscal.exempt-grocer.basis: No national poll; broad bipartisan state support

us-policy-positions:fiscal.fund-pensions.poll: No direct poll; public favors paying promised pensions

us-policy-positions:fiscal.graduated-inc.poll: Pew, 2023, upper-income people pay too little (~60%); IL Fair Tax 2020 got 47%

us-policy-positions:fiscal.minimum-reser.poll: No direct poll; rainy-day savings broadly favored

us-policy-positions:government-operation.poll: Pew, Feb 2024, any voter may vote by mail without excuse (57%)
us-policy-positions:government-operation.basis: No-excuse mail support, discounted for mailing ballots to all

us-policy-positions:government-operation.poll: Pew, Feb 2024, automatically register all eligible citizens
Program for Public Consultation, lobbying cooling-off period for former lawmakers
us-policy-positions:government-operation.basis: Federal wording as proxy for state

us-policy-positions:government-operation.poll: Pew, local government viewed more favorably than state (~2/3)
us-policy-positions:government-operation.basis: Trust in local government as proxy for home rule

us-policy-positions:government-operation.poll: Multiple polls, about two-thirds back independent commissions; OH Issue 1 (2024) lost 46%
us-policy-positions:government-operation.basis: Poll average discounted by 2024 ballot loss

us-policy-positions:government-operation.poll: Pew, Sept 2023, term limits for Congress (87%)
Pew, Aug 2025, require government-issued photo ID to vote
Pew, 2021-2024, allow registration on Election Day

us-policy-positions:health-human-service.poll: Ballot: expansion passed in 7 states 2017-2022 (SD 2022 56%); KFF polling
us-policy-positions:health-human-service.basis: Ballot results plus KFF; party split approximate

us-policy-positions:health-human-service.poll: KFF, Feb 2025, work requirements for Medicaid adults (falls to 32% when told most already work)

us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.all.poll: YouGov and Pew, 2023-2024, allow apartments/duplexes in single-family areas

us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.inc.poll: No direct national poll; affordable housing mandates generally favored

us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.ren.poll: YouGov 2024 national; NV Apr 2024 65% (D 81, R 56); CA Prop 33 (2024) lost 40%
us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.ren.basis: Polls favor; ballot results cut against

us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rig.poll: Data for Progress, 2021, guarantee lawyers for tenants facing eviction

us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.poll: Johns Hopkins National Survey of Gun Policy, 2023, safe-storage requirements
Harvard CAPS/Harris, 56% oppose eliminating cash bail; other national polls 45% favor
us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.basis: Direct but wording-sensitive; no party split

us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.poll: Harvard CAPS/Harris, early 2026, state and local should cooperate with federal immigration officials
Marquette Law School national, May 2022, concealed carry without a license (19% favor)
us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.basis: Yes = require a permit; party split approximate

us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.poll: Morning Consult/Politico, May 2022, minimum age 21 to buy guns
No direct national poll; youth justice surveys favor juvenile court for 17-year-olds
Pew, Apr 2021, allow people convicted of felonies to vote after serving sentences; FL Amendment 4 (2018) 65%

us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.loca.poll: No direct poll; local control and minimum wage support blended
us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.loca.basis: Estimated from minimum wage and local-control polling

us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.publ.poll: Gallup union approval 68% (Aug 2025); OH SB5 repeal (2011) 61%

us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.rais.poll: Pew, Apr 2021, $15 federal minimum; Ballot 2024: MO 58%, AK 58% passed, CA $18 lost 49%
us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.rais.basis: Ballot measures pass in red states near 58%

us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.righ.poll: Gallup, Aug 2014, would vote for right-to-work law (71-22); MO Prop A (2018) rejected 67%
us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.righ.basis: Only national poll predates 2020; ballot cuts the other way

us-policy-positions:technology-privacy.a.poll: Pew, June 2026, require age verification before using social media

us-policy-positions:technology-privacy.c.poll: Pew, Oct 2023, more government regulation of how companies use personal data

us-policy-positions:technology-privacy.r.poll: Pew, 2022, police use of facial recognition (46% good idea, 27% bad)
us-policy-positions:technology-privacy.r.basis: Inverse of police-use support, among those with an opinion

us-policy-positions:transportation-infra.poll: Mineta Transportation Institute annual survey, 2023, flat mileage fee
us-policy-positions:transportation-infra.basis: Survey support for mileage fees well under half
Infrastructure polling as proxy for public networks

us-policy-positions:transportation-infra.poll: Transportation for America and Pew polling, 2020-2023, transit vs road spending
